label: Episode 17
logline: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
continuity_notes: Picks up the morning after Episode 16's moonlit confrontation where Alexander defended Juliana and defeated Harrington's hired thugs in her medicinal garden.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 17, 1 segment(s), 24s
[00:07.00-00:11.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.
[00:09.30-00:11.30] JULIANA (Soft, Emotional): "Some of them survived."
[00:11.50-00:14.00] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.
[00:11.50-00:14.00] SOUND: Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.
[00:11.50-00:14.00] ACTION: Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.
[00:14.00-00:16.20] CAMERA: Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.
[00:14.30-00:15.30] JULIANA (Grateful, Sincere): "Thank you."
[00:16.20-00:18.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.
[00:16.80-00:17.80] ALEXANDER (Gruff, Low): "For what?"
[00:18.00-00:21.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.
[00:18.20-00:20.50] JULIANA (Trembling, Heartfelt): "For standing between me and those men."
[00:21.00-00:23.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.
[00:21.50-00:23.00] ALEXANDER (Unwavering, Firm): "I would do it again."
[00:23.50-00:25.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.
[00:24.00-00:25.70] JULIANA (Whispering, Awed): "Even if there were ten of them?"
[00:26.00-00:27.70] ALEXANDER (Deep, Resolute): "As long as I draw breath..."
[00:26.50-00:30.00] CAMERA: Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
[00:28.00-00:31.25] ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.
[00:28.80-00:31.00] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Vowing): "...no one will hurt you again."

[00:39.00-00:42.00] CAMERA: Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
[00:40.00-00:44.50] ACTION: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
[00:42.00-00:45.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.
[00:42.80-00:44.70] JULIANA (Tender, Reproachful): "You were bleeding last night."
[00:45.00-00:48.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.
[00:46.00-00:47.30] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Fond): "So were you."
[00:48.50-00:51.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.
[00:49.00-00:51.50] JULIANA (Softly Teasing): "You make it very difficult to argue with you."
[00:51.50-00:54.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.
[00:53.50-00:56.00] ACTION: Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.
[00:54.00-00:58.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.
[00:56.50-00:58.00] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Sincere): "I was frightened."
[00:58.50-01:00.05] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.
[00:58.80-00:59.80] ALEXANDER (Questioning): "Of them?"
